about: Pointer-target measurement over the built pages (Prompt 283): the rule, the exceptions it allows and what each page measured at a phone (375 px) and a tablet (768 px) with touch emulation. e2e/mobileSweep.spec.js holds every page to the rule; GRAVITAS_TARGETS_WRITE=1 rewrites `measured` (read the diff). tests/touchTargets.test.js holds the record to the walk inventory.
rule: A target is at least 24 x 24 CSS px (WCAG 2.5.8; a slider is judged by its height), or it meets an exception below. under44 counts the targets that are not inline and are under 44 x 44 on a touch screen: it is recorded, not required; the controls the layout spec names are held to 44 by e2e/responsiveLayout.spec.js.

exceptions.spacing: A target under 24 px passes if a 24 px circle centred on it meets no other target and no other undersized target's circle (2.5.8, Spacing).
exceptions.inline: A link in a sentence of other words (at least eight letters or digits of text around it, in a block that is not a flex or grid row) is exempt and not enlarged (2.5.8, Inline).
exceptions.control: A control the browser draws and the page cannot resize: a file picker, a colour, date or time input (2.5.8, User agent control).
